bluf: Location3 is a Denver performance marketing agency, founded 1999, built for franchise and multi location brands and sold through LOCALACT, its platform tying national strategy to location level results. The record shows it productising: LocalScore added in 2026-02, location level GA4 in 2025-11, and GEO for AI Overviews sold beside listings. The one thing a rival should know: its house fails 3 of 5 say and do tests (no llms.txt, no social pixel, no LinkedIn ads of its own) and 5 of 6 named clients are names only. It is likely, with moderate confidence, beatable on proof rather than on platform.
doing:

In plain words: a local marketing shop whose product is a dashboard, with media sold around it. The headline claim comes from its own Google ads, which bill it the #1 digital marketing agency for franchise and multi unit brands; the work page cites Drum Marketing Awards and Franchise Innovation Awards recognition and the press archive a 2024 Inc. Regionals award.

Six core lines sit at score 2: AI Search / GEO (a GEO page on AI Overviews and zero click results), Data & Measurement (marketing tied to leads and revenue, location level GA4), Paid Search (an AI Max case, Local Services Ads, a Keplr Vision case), Paid Social (audits and creative reviews), Programmatic & CTV (a Wild Birds Unlimited CTV case) and SEO (pieces for pest control and HVAC). The AI posture sells GEO for AI Overviews and map results, casts listings data as fuel for AI answers and stresses human advice over automation; the Horus read scores P1 partial and P6 absent. Pricing signals are absent (P5 unknown).

openings:
The contradictions to lead with are observed: it sells GEO for AI Overviews and publishes no llms.txt; it sells paid social and runs no social pixel on its own site; it sells paid social or B2B demand gen and runs no LinkedIn ads. It is likely, with moderate confidence, that a rival who shows a franchise prospect Location3's own house beside its #1 claim wins the paid social and GEO lines, since no audited AI visibility product (P1 partial) answers it. The falsifier: an llms.txt and a social pixel on location3.com at the next compile.

Second, price. No public pricing model shows (P5 unknown) and the Monsoon displacement read is 68.9 on a mid market book: an offshore delivered or outcome priced rival can very likely, with moderate confidence, undercut the Local and SEO hours, though the read is inferred.

Third, the book. 5 of 6 named clients are names only, a question to ask HoneyBaked Ham, UFC Gym or Mountain Mike's Pizza. The defensible ground is real: LOCALACT with LocalScore and Local GA4, LSAs (P3 making) and the inputs for automation (P4 making). A rival is unlikely to beat it on platform; the opening is proof and price.
